messages:
Priya Rao: PR #6148 renames eviction metrics and changes the label key from `model` -> `model_version`. Need cross-team review + LGTM. Target ship Wed 3pm PT. cc @Diego @Alex (runtime), @Maya (platform), @Sam (infra), @Lena (security) :wave:
Diego Chen: looking now — what's the migration plan for dashboards/alerts? If we rename the label we lose older metrics filters.
Priya Rao: good q. plan is to emit both labels for a short window and then flip. snippet in PR: ```yaml
metrics:
  - name: evictions_total
    labels:
      - model: '{{model}}'
      - model_version: '{{model_version}}'
```
we'll gate dual-write behind a rollout flag.
Maya Patel: Platform note — we need an opt-in telemetry flag, and a short docs/Grafana runbook for dashboard owners to update filters.
Sam O'Neill: Infra: will run perf/cardinality checks. Is model_version high-card? that could spike TSDB.
Priya Rao: model_version cardinality is small (~10 active versions). I'll add a feature flag `emit_model_version` and emit both keys for the window.
Lena Brooks: Security check — any chance labels leak PII? model_version should be safe but confirm there are no free-text labels.
Alex Kim: Runtime: can you paste microbench results for dual-write? also confirm no hot-path kv references to `model` label that could regress latency.
Priya Rao: adding bench results to PR now. kv path not touched. microbench summary: `qps=2000 threads=8` before: p50=1.02ms, after: p50=1.024ms — ~0.4% CPU overhead, negligible. full numbers in PR description.
Diego Chen: runtime ok with that perf. can we keep dual-emits for 72h instead of 48h to give dashboards time to update?
Priya Rao: yes can do 72h. I'll update rollout duration.
Maya Patel: I'll own docs + Grafana updates. Proposed canary window Thu 09:00-11:00 PT — ok?
Sam O'Neill: Infra will monitor ingestion/storage and alert on cardinality increase during window. I'll add an alert and keep an eye.
Lena Brooks: Security OK with 72h and no PII. LGTM from security.
Alex Kim: I can be merge steward and run the canary. request platform + infra explicit sign-off before I merge.
Maya Patel: LGTM from platform once docs PR is linked into the main PR.
Sam O'Neill: LGTM infra after I validate the perf artifacts — ping me after you attach them.
Priya Rao: thanks all — attaching benches + docs link to PR now and marking canary Thu 09:00-11:00 PT. tagging merge steward @Alex. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled canary window Thu 09:00-11:00 PT. Auto-rollout disabled until manual trigger.
